title: Stochastic Kinetics
description: In a cell there may be ten molecules of something: reactions happen one at a time, at random moments. Gillespie simulated them exactly.

puzzle.goal: Reactions fire at a total rate a. With a random number u between 0 and 1, write how long W to wait until the next one.
puzzle.name: Gillespie wait
puzzle.ask: Find W for u = @{u} and a = @{a}.
puzzle.method: Waiting times at a steady rate are exponential: P(wait > t) = e^(−at). Set that equal to u and solve for t.
